text:
beth: quick sync — sketching an 'onramp credit bridge' to reduce churn between trial credits and first commit. need to validate constraints, launch criteria, and sales requirements.

julio: +1. customers ask for a short safety net for first-month spikes. example: early startup expecting sudden user growth during launch week.

eng-kai: doable. two systems: issuance/expiry of temporary credits; auto-conversion rules on commit. edge cases: partial conversion when commit < bridge usage, refunds, and concurrent promos.

finance-nick: accounting concern: how to treat credits for revenue recognition. prefer 'expire-without-value' model to avoid prepaid liability. need note in playbook.

legal-lena: contract language must say "bridge credits are promotional, non-transferable, expire after N days". if region pricing differs, include residency clause.

maria: rollout must be self-serve in console + sales UI toggle. telemetry events: bridge_offered, bridge_accepted, bridge_consumed, bridge_expired. migration path for active trials required.

oleg: metrics to track: 30d and 90d conversion delta, MRR retention uplift, top customers by bridge usage. propose A/B: 50% of eligible trials get offer for 8 weeks.

design-anya: UX: simple modal: "Bridge offer — covers short-term usage spikes for N days. Accept/Decline. View terms." default opt-in off; sales can opt-in for a customer.

julio: sales needs script + one-pager. clarify SLA: bridge is just credits, no priority routing or reserved capacity unless customer buys Dedicated.

eng-kai: confirm — bridge does not change QoS. if customer requests capacity guarantees, route to Dedicated sales path.

beth: proposed default config example:

bridge:
  duration_days: 30
  cap_percent_of_trial: 50
  opt_in: true
  expiry_action: "revert_to_paid_quota"
  allow_conversion: true

This gives up to 50% of trial monthly spend as a one-time bridge valid for 30 days; opt-in required.

finance-nick: tweak: bridge non-refundable and expires to zero value; document GAAP rationale.

beth: draft launch criteria:
- legal sign-off on T&C
- finance sign-off on accounting approach
- eng automation + telemetry implemented
- sales one-pager + console UI
- internal pilot with 10 customers for 2 weeks
- rollback plan for abuse

oleg: add alerting: flag accounts with >50% bridge consumption within 7 days for manual review.

billing-bot: "Reminder: test account sandbox created: acct-bridge-pilot-01" :robot_face:

julio: pricing examples for sales (two variants: conservative/aggressive) help. can we create small table?

beth: mock examples:
Starter | $500/mo commit | up to $250 one-time bridge (30d)
Scale   | $2k/mo commit   | up to $800 one-time bridge (30d)

Conservative = 50% cap, aggressive = 100% of trial.

eng-kai: run conservative pilot first (50%). fewer edge cases.

maria: timeline: PRD end of week, eng spike next week, pilot in 3 weeks.

beth: action items: @eng-kai automation design due in 3 days; @legal-lena T&C snippet; @finance-nick confirm accounting; @julio pick 3 pilot customers. I'll own PRD and pilot coordination.

julio: shared candidate list by EOD. :thumbsup: 

beth: if no objections by EOD tomorrow I'll lock PRD and schedule eng spike.
